programme.title: New Life
programme.desc: It's a water world and life couldn't survive without it. And thanks to it, a mind blowing diversity of creatures thrive beneath the surface. Born to enjoy the riches underwater they must master their body's adaptations, learn to find food, to escape danger and above all become expert swimmers! Whether it's in rivers, on beaches or in the deep ocean, all must overcome the obstacles and fulfil their destiny, all are born to swim! Of all the habitats on earth, the ocean is perhaps the most challenging. Here salt, temperatures, currents and predators can make life difficult; it's not an obvious place to want to bring up your babies… But even in these waters generation after generation beats the odds. They have overcome the challenges and become some of the most beautiful and graceful of creatures. But any baby born to swim has a lot to learn… All over the world there are creatures born to swim, and though humans are not, we seem determined to join them. Perhaps we are envious of their grace. Maybe we are all water babies at heart

programme.desc: On February 15th, 2013, out of the blue, a meteorite exploded in the earth’s atmosphere above the Russian region of Chelyabinsk. The event is a reminder of the ever-present 'Meteor Menace' and the need to understand more about these missiles from outer space.

programme.title: The Seychelles - Africa with South Seas ambience
programme.desc: The 115 islands and islets that make up the Seychelles present a breath-taking variety of plants, rare animals and beaches laced with palms. This is where the leg-endary Coco de Mer palm nuts grow with fruits weigh-ing up to 20 kilos and giant wild land turtles nibble away at mangrove fruits to their hearts content. The archipelago was first settled at the end of the 18th cen-tury. Today, a very colourful potpourri of peoples in this dwarf state proves just how peacefully different cultures can live side by side. Three times a week, the steamer "MV Espoir" completes the trip from the main island of Mahé to Praslin and back. A ship for every-one and practically everything: Used cars, toilet paper, horses, bicycles, furniture - you name it, the Espoir transports goods of all kinds. Coconuts sometimes pose a problem as there are far too many of them. What to do with them? The best place to send them is undoubt-edly Hubert Roumien's Virgin Coconut Oil Laboratory, hidden away in the Mahé jungle. Straw turns into gold at Seaweed Seychelles! There, Benjamin Port Louis collects seaweed and extracts liquid fertiliser from it.

programme.title: Vicious Beauties - The secret World of the Jelly Fish
programme.desc: Watching the graceful movement of these gelatinous animals is almost hypnotic. Although their bodies are 98% water, jellyfish are deceptively clever and dangerous. But where do these primordial creatures come from? How do they reproduce and how long do they live?

programme.title: Chiemgau, A Changing Landscape
programme.desc: A few thousand years ago, there were bare moraine ridges and barren meltwater valleys here. A landscape born in the last ice age, characterized by the edge of the Alps, gentle hills, moors, and lakes. And by cultural richness, not only on the islands in Lake Chiemsee, with their famous monasteries and castles. Long before King Ludwig II, the first people settled in the Chiemgau region. Finds of hunting weapons from the Neanderthal era prove that the land was inhabited even during the ice age, probably because there was plenty of game to hunt. During the Bronze Age, one of the most important trade routes from the mountains to the Alpine foothills passed through here. Then came the Celts and the Romans.

programme.title: Chiemgau, A Changing Landscape
programme.desc: Three times in the past two decades, the Chiemsee area has experienced "once-in-a-century" floods. Climate, wildlife, and landscape have changed, and it seems this transformation is accelerating. Species living in the flood zones are developing sophisticated survival strategies. Knot ants, for instance, place their queen in the middle and form a raft with their bodies, even conquering new habitats. Flooding is less of a disaster for nature and impacts humans more significantly.

programme.title: mareTV: Sweden's High Coast
programme.desc: Sweden's Höga Kusten (High Coast) has been rising by almost one centimetre per year since the last ice age 10,000 years ago. This has created a hilly Baltic Sea landscape on the Gulf of Bothnia with small and large islands. Untouched nature, dense forests and energetic, rather idiosyncratic islanders have plenty of room there. Every year at the end of August a biting stench mixes with the fresh Baltic Sea breeze. For weeks the so-called sour herring, Swedish: Surströmming, is fermented in brine. Ruben Madsen is a producer of surströmming and an absolute connoisseur. In his wooden hut on the island of Ulvön he puts the herring in according to a traditional recipe. At the start of the season, the cans are opened for the first time. Lovers of the "stinky fish" then come from all over the world to taste the now world-famous delicacy in cans. Opening the cans of "rotten fish" is considered internationally as a test of courage, people film themselves doing so, the inhabitants of the High Coast can only smile about it.

programme.title: mareTV: Estonia's Enchanted Islands - Kihnu, Hiiumaa, Saaremaa & Co
programme.desc: Kihnu is one of 19 inhabited Estonian islands. When the women there ride motorcycles in colourful skirts, it is summer. Thanks to its remoteness, charming traditions have been preserved here. More than 2,000 islands belong to Estonia, none is like the other, each with its own character. Most of them were military restricted areas during the Soviet Union. Of all things, the strict shielding had its good points: beach, forest, juniper groves, they still characterise the landscape of Estonia's enchanted islands. Elly Karjam is a "multi-jobber": lighthouse keeper, ice-cream producer and contract knitter for the famous Kihnu sweaters. Summer is high season for her: She is expecting guests from the USA, who had their ancestors on Kihnu. Birches have to be cut for the so-called viht. This bunch of birch branches is an important accessory for the traditional sauna at midsummer. And the motorcycles in the shed are to be refloated.

programme.title: Secrets of the Mediterranean
programme.desc: The contours of the Mediterranean have changed during the course of its history. Near Gibraltar, Africa was once connected to the European continent. When the land bridge at Gibraltar collapsed, the Mediterranean basin filled up again. The Suez Canal is today connected to the Red Sea. This route enables animals to reach the Mediterranean, where they cause problems.

programme.title: Secrets of the Mediterranean
programme.desc: Rugged rocks, blue sea and idyllic, sandy beaches - this is the Mediterranean as we know it. But this impression is deceptive: the Mediterranean is under constant change. Captain Dylan Hunt und eine bunt zusammengewürfelte Raumschiffcrew setzen alles daran, wieder Ordnung zu schaffen und die galaxisweite Kooperation der Planeten zu erneuern - ein äußerst gefährliches Unternehmen!

programme.title: Rescue Team
programme.desc: Sur une ile Asiatique, une équipe de scientifiques étudie la récente apparition d’un virus mortel. Ce dernier prend la forme d’une maladie dégénérescente et les habitants locaux en sont les premières victimes. Après avoir découvert l’existence d’un « elixir de vie », les scientifiques vont disparaitre en laissant derrière eux un message d’alerte concernant cette terrible maladie qui se propage rapidement. Les forces armées internationales et des mercenaires prêts à tout, débarquent sur l’ile avec un enjeu majeur, la survie de l’humanité pour certains mais surtout de nombreux intérêts personnels.

programme.title: Triple Action
programme.desc: Une mercenaire sexy et mortelle s'attaque à un syndicat international de trafiquants d'armes dirigé par la mafia russe.

programme.title: Dernières Heures de la Terre
programme.desc: Après que de la matière dense provenant d’un trou blanc implosé ait frappé la Terre, la rotation de la planète est dévastée. Un groupe d’agents gouvernementaux doit retrouver un réseau de satellites perdu, seul espoir de survie pour l’humanité.

programme.title: Age of the Dragons
programme.desc: Le roman classique Moby Dick de Herman Melville est recréé dans un monde où le capitaine Achab et son équipage sont à la recherche d'un grand dragon blanc.

programme.title: Funeral Killers
programme.desc: Un jeu du chat et de la souris se déroule au cours d'une seule nuit, lorsque trois criminels armés font irruption dans une morgue et exigent que le médecin légiste et son assistant leur remettent une balle logée dans un cadavre. Alors que les criminels tentent désespérément de cacher leur véritable identité, le médecin se retrouve de plus en plus enlisé dans un bourbier, son passé le rattrapant malgré lui. Chaque rebondissement explosif pousse bientôt les personnages au-delà de leurs limites.

programme.title: Midnight Heat
programme.desc: Un banquier amnésique se cache de la police lorsqu'il est accusé du meurtre de sa femme.

programme.title: Vampire Killers
programme.desc: Leurs femmes ayant été réduites en esclavage par la meute locale de vampires lesbiennes à cause d'une ancienne malédiction, les hommes restants d'un village rural envoient deux jeunes garçons malheureux dans les landes pour les sacrifier.

programme.title: The eXtremists
programme.desc: Une équipe de tournage se rend dans les Alpes autrichiennes, près de l’ancienne frontière yougoslave, pour filmer trois passionnés de sports extrêmes poursuivis par une avalanche pour une publicité. Ce qu’ils ignorent, c’est qu’ils tournent à proximité de la cachette secrète de Slobodan Pavle, un criminel de guerre serbe. L’ayant accidentellement filmé, ils se retrouvent entraînés dans une course-poursuite mortelle à travers les montagnes, mêlant ski, snowboard, parachutisme, rafting, hélicoptères, motos et base jump.

programme.title: The Tower
programme.desc: Au cour de la « White Christmas » parti du complexe ultra-luxueux « Sky Tower », un feu se déclare. Le feu a commencé lorsque les hélicoptères supposés saupoudrer de la neige au-dessus du bâtiment sont entrés en contact avec le bâtiment. Les pompiers sont rapidement envoyés afin de sauver l’ensemble des locataires et les invités VIP du building.

programme.title: L'Ange Gardien
programme.desc: Après avoir enquêté sur une série de crimes violents, deux inspecteurs de la police de Los Angeles découvrent une nouvelle drogue liée à un pouvoir surnaturel terrifiant.

programme.title: Crash lunaire
programme.desc: Deux entreprises, l'une sidérurgique et l'autre aérospatiale, décident de s'associer afin d'exploiter les ressources de la Lune. Mais, un accident de forage provoque une fissure et précipite un morceau de l'astre sélène vers la Terre.

programme.title: Exit Speed
programme.desc: Dix passagers d'un bus se retrouvent bloqués dans une casse après avoir été chassés de la route par des motards. Pour survivre, ils doivent improviser des armes et avoir le courage de se défendre contre les motards meurtriers.

programme.title: L'enfant d'Osiris
programme.desc: Dans une époque de colonisation interplanétaire, Sy Lombrok (Kellan Lutz), un ancien infirmier devenu vagabond au passé tourmenté, forme une alliance improbable avec Kane Sommerville (Daniel MacPherson), un lieutenant travaillant pour le sous-traitant militaire Exor. Dans une course contre la montre, ils tentent de sauver Indi (Teagan Croft), la jeune fille de Kane, alors qu’une crise mondiale imminente provoquée par Exor menace la planète.

programme.title: American Ninja 5
programme.desc: Lorsque la fille d'un scientifique est kidnappée, American Ninja (David Bradley) tente de la retrouver, mais cette fois-ci, il fait équipe avec un jeune qu'il a formé aux techniques du ninja.

programme.title: Les Impitoyables
programme.desc: Un prêtre et son frère jumeau se relaient pour défendre une petite ville contre le gang vicieux des Clayton.

programme.title: Les cavaliers du destin
programme.desc: Le méchant Kincaid contrôle l'approvisionnement local en eau et prévoit de se débarrasser des autres éleveurs. L'agent gouvernemental Saunders se présente sous couverture pour se débarrasser de Kincaid et gagner le cœur d'une de ses victimes, Fay Denton.

programme.title: New Mexico
programme.desc: Un capitaine de cavalerie a beaucoup de mal à maintenir la paix entre son colonel tyrannique et un chef indien déterminé à se venger.

programme.title: Le Rocher du Diable
programme.desc: Deux vieux amis se retrouvent dans des camps opposés pendant la guerre civile lors d'une bataille désespérée au sommet d'une montagne imprenable.

programme.title: Quatre pour Sartana
programme.desc: Sept bandits masqués enlèvent la jeune Susy, cousine du maire de Clayton City, Frank Clonny. Frank accepte la rançon de 15 000 dollars demandée par les bandits et réfléchit à un plan qui lui permettra de récupérer l'argent et de capturer les hors-la-loi.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: Une bande de hors-la-loi dévalise la banque de Virginia City et s'empare de la quasi-totalité de l'argent. Le plus jeune membre de la bande réussit à se faire embaucher sur le Ponderosa en tant que bronciste, avec l'intention d'informer les voleurs de banque de tout possesseur susceptible de menacer leur repaire. Alors que Ben, Adam et Hoss accueillent le nouveau venu, Little Joe se méfie de ses activités.

programme.title: Le Vent de la Justice
programme.desc: Dans le Far West anarchique, un jeune homme et son frère sont contraints de partir en voyage pour venger la mort de leur père, protéger la tribu Apache qu'ils ont appris à aimer et récupérer la terre et l'or qui leur appartiennent de droit.

programme.title: Le temps du massacre
programme.desc: Un chercheur d'or et son demi-frère ivrogne doivent affronter un fermier et son fils sadique après avoir pris le contrôle de sa ferme.

programme.title: Le Banni
programme.desc: Les légendes occidentales Pat Garrett, Doc Holliday et Billy the Kid s'affrontent pour prévaloir sur la loi et pour gagner les attentions de la vive renarde de campagne, Rio McDonald.

programme.title: Corsicana
programme.desc: Le shérif adjoint Bass Reeves retrouve son ancien partenaire et fugitif Sam Tanner. Avec un ancien tireur d'élite de l'Union, ils font face à une course contre la montre pour retrouver Jack Donner et sa bande impitoyable de tueurs.

programme.title: Clayton L'implacable
programme.desc: La sœur de Clayton est violée et assassinée. L'heure de la vengeance mortelle a sonné !

programme.title: Acquasanta Joe
programme.desc: Une bande de voleurs armés d'un canon de l'armée de l'Union dévalisent la banque où se trouve la prime du tueur Acquasanta Joe. Il se lance à leur poursuite, les croisant et les doublant sur son chemin.

programme.title: Winnetou II : LE TRESOR DES MONTAGNES BLEUES
programme.desc: Forester, un impitoyable baron du pétrole, veut déclencher une guerre entre les tribus amérindiennes et les hommes blancs. Old Shatterhand, Winnetou et leur acolyte Castlepool tentent de l'empêcher.

programme.title: Retour a Legend City
programme.desc: Enfant, il a vu son père prédicateur se faire assassiner. En tant que soldat, il a été témoin des horreurs de la guerre civile. Aujourd'hui, le chasseur de primes James Conners est de retour à Legend, au Nouveau-Mexique, pour capturer le baron terrien psychotique qui a détruit son enfance.

programme.title: Né dans la Mauvaise Famille
programme.desc: Un jeune garçon prend position lorsque le chagrin de sa mère menace de détruire leur vie à tous les deux.

programme.title: Coup de foudre à Mumbai
programme.desc: Après le crash de son avion, Sarah a été recueillie par les habitants d'un village près de Mumbai. La jeune femme devient le guide de Max, un routier engagé par Oskar, dont elle a pour mission de le conduire à son village. Mais les choses se compliquent lorsque Sarah découvre qu'Oskar veut chasser les villageois pour monter un projet en vue des Jeux Olympiques.

programme.title: Vengeance du passé
programme.desc: Une femme retourne chez elle pour enquêter sur la mort mystérieuse de ses amis d'enfance.

programme.title: Coup de foudre en Toscane
programme.desc: Un jeune écrivain en herbe suit un titan littéraire souffrant du blocage des écrivains jusqu'à son refuge dans l'Italie rurale et découvre la vie et l'amour du génie irascible et de ses filles.

programme.title: Un hiver à Central Park
programme.desc: L'histoire d'une femme confrontée à la mort de sa fille en bas âge, tout en essayant de préserver son mariage et sa relation avec son beau-fils.

programme.title: La mémoire de mon pays
programme.desc: Langston Whitfield est journaliste au Washington Post. Son rédacteur en chef l’envoie en Afrique du Sud pour couvrir les audiences de la Commission Vérité et Réconciliation, où les auteurs de meurtres et de tortures des deux camps durant l’Apartheid sont invités à se présenter et à affronter leurs victimes. En disant la vérité sans fard et en exprimant des remords, ils peuvent obtenir l’amnistie. Les profondes blessures de l’Apartheid peuvent-elles être guéries par la réconciliation ?

programme.title: Présomption d'innocence
programme.desc: Une femme est reconnue coupable d'avoir tué son petit ami et sa meilleure amie dans le feu de la passion bien qu'elle ait été défendue par un avocat de renom. Elle s'enfuit après le procès afin de découvrir qui l'a piégée.

programme.title: La Disparue
programme.desc: Le corps de Yoon Seol Hee disparaît à l'Institut National d'Investigation Scientifique. Le détective Woo Joong Shik cherche des indices sur sa disparition, tandis que son mari Park Jin Han affirme qu'elle est en vie.

programme.title: Mes Deux amours
programme.desc: Hadrien se lance à la recherche de la femme qu'il aime, Barbara, qui a disparu sans lui donner de nouvelles. Personne ne veut entendre ses angoisses sauf un autre homme, qui affirme à Hadrien que la femme de sa vie est la sienne... La rencontre entre les deux amants de Barbara a lieu à l'endroit où elle a été aperçue pour la dernière fois : la bergerie dont elle a hérité de sa mère. Hadrien Darcourt est arrivé en 4x4, Emmanuel Devailly, en stop. Hadrien est encore en costume, Emmanuel est déjà en tenue de campagne. Hadrien a fait appel à la gendarmerie, Emmanuel à son instinct. Bref, tout les oppose, mais ils aiment tous deux Barbara Cantarella, 45 ans, grand reporter

programme.title: Basket
programme.desc: Une communauté pittoresque du nord-ouest du Pacifique élevant son blé et ses enfants au milieu d'une nation ébranlée par la Première Guerre mondiale est à l'origine de The Basket. À une époque de douleur et de préjugés tissés sur fond de beauté, The Basket évoque finalement le triomphe et l'espoir dans une Amérique en pleine mutation.

programme.title: My life is murder s1
programme.desc: Intrépide et espiègle, elle agit par instinct ; à la fois ange vengeur et un peu provocatrice ; profondément empathique et franche à en être parfois impolie. Elle possède aussi un sens de l’humour irrévérencieux. À part le fait que son mari est décédé il y a quelques années, peu de gens savent grand-chose sur Alexa ou sur les raisons pour lesquelles elle a quitté la police, faisant d’elle un véritable mystère. Et Alexa ne peut pas résister à un mystère, alors lorsque son ancien collègue et ami de longue date, l’inspecteur Kieran Hussey, lui demande de consulter sur ses affaires les plus complexes, elle semble hésitante. Mais en réalité, elle ne peut pas dire non. Pour résoudre l’insolvable, Alexa est accompagnée de Madison, pétillante, sarcastique, ambitieuse et terre-à-terre. Véritable extravertie, Madison travaille comme analyste de données pour la police et répond toujours présente lorsque Alexa fait appel à ses talents.

programme.title: The Other Me
programme.desc: Un architecte est atteint d'une maladie oculaire qui l'introduit dans une réalité surréaliste dans laquelle il voit les motivations des gens. Les visions devenant intolérables, il tombe amoureux d'une femme mystérieuse.

programme.title: L'Histoire de l'Amour
programme.desc: The story of a long-lost book that mysteriously reappears and connects an old man searching for his son with a girl seeking a cure for her mother's loneliness.

programme.title: Back Home
programme.desc: Drug kingpin Jay looks to expand his drug empire with the help of his business partners, and his girlfriend Passion. However, Polo and Marco have their own agenda’s, which could lead to chaos, as a potential drug war descends upon Atlanta.

programme.title: The Groomer
programme.desc: Layla is a young and attractive woman who meets Bryce in her teen years, and he is who she claims to be the love of her life. Unbeknownst to her, Bryse is manipulating her and forming her into his own object of desire. Layla is under his spell, until a different side of him that could destroy her.

programme.title: The Agony and the Ecstasy
programme.desc: When rival gangster Derrick Smith is released from prison, the beef with Armand Rossi explodes into an all-out war in Fountain City, MO. After a hit on his family , Armand goes into killer mode. Derrick and Vic Moore team up for revenge , but Rossi and his partner Qua stay ahead. When they involve Dr. Monica Gaye in the plot , she flips the script to survive. A devastating loss sends a grieving Armand past the point of no return , forcing him to eliminate every one of his opps.

programme.title: Apex
programme.desc: A special ops team enters the underground bunker "Hades" to rescue missing scientists, only to uncover a terrifying secret far beyond their expectations.

programme.title: Carmen and Magic
programme.desc: When Carmen meets a new friend at school named Magic, she helps raise her spirits and allows her to stand up for herself. When her single father Drew starts seeing the school principal, Magic convinces Carmen to disrupt their relationship, pulling the veil on Magic’s sinister nature.

programme.title: But I'm Married
programme.desc: Kimora and Jamal, a successful power couple, face a dwindling passion in their marriage. Seeking to reignite their spark, Kimora explores unconventional options, including introducing a third person. This decision unleashes a whirlwind of hidden desires, lies, and betrayals. As secrets surface and trust erodes, Kimora must confront the consequences of her choices and rebuild her life, navigating the complexities of desire and the fragility of her marriage.

programme.title: Heart of a Woman
programme.desc: Alisha, a rising model with a bright future, chose to put her career on hold to stand by her football star husband Jax. When an opportunity arises for her to return to the runway, their marriage is put to the test, and whether love or career holds the most weight in their relationship.

programme.title: Love Unexpected
programme.desc: Chase is a young and confident college student, who is a self-proclaimed “ladies man” but also feels that love is for suckers. That is until he meets his match Kary, the fiercely independent student who isn’t interested in wasting time on anything casual. Chase sees Kary as a challenge and the ultimate prize, but is he willing to give up his playboy ways for true love?

programme.title: Father Knows Best
programme.desc: Zoe Miles, raised by a controlling father who introduces her to a life of crime, grapples with the lingering trauma of her mother's death. Yearning to embrace the spiritual life she shared with her grandmother, Zoe finds herself trapped in a cycle of violence, forced to rob drug dealers after witnessing a terrifying crime. Desperate to escape this destructive path, she struggles against her father's suffocating control, fearing the loss of his approval and the validation she desperately seeks.

When the remains of an apartheid-era policeman are discovered 60 years after he went missing, a retired singer revisits her past to help with the investigation. But how much does she know, and what is she holding back?

programme.title: Murder on the Pole
programme.desc: One night Bunny was the queen of the dance floor; the next, she was a chalk outline. Dismissed by a department eager to sweep a "club girl's" death under the rug, Lola refuses to let her sister’s killer walk free. To find the murderer, Lola must infiltrate the world that claimed Bunny’s life—a world of predatory regulars, backstage betrayals, and a cover-up that goes higher than she ever imagined.

programme.title: Don't Miss the Bus
programme.desc: Sierra, a single mother hustles in order to survive with long shifts and grunt work. Her faith is pinned on lottery tickets and men who exploit her vulnerability. When a stroke of luck has the ability to change her future forever, a missed bus stop could mean life or death.

programme.title: Taking What's Mine
programme.desc: Jordan Hayes, a decorated Army veteran turned rising political icon is thrown into a harrowing disaster when her journalist husband, Ethan, is captured by a rising terrorist leader, Khalid Rami. Rami will only release Ethan if Jordan helps overturn a new counter terrorism bill. Refusing to fight the red tape and bow to pressure, Jordan takes matters into her own hands and sets out to rescue him herself.

programme.title: Broken Harmony
programme.desc: Recording artist Harmony Brown, listens to every suggestion from her record label including changing her sound, changing her look, and even changing the type of music she sang. Yet, her numbers aren’t improving, and she’s on the verge of being released from her contract. Her manager, suggests she returns to Atlanta and meet with a power house music producer to give her a refresh on her sound. However, she’s forced to stay with and reunite with her mother, and address the trauma of her childhood.

programme.title: Monster Jam Replay
programme.desc: Monster Jam Replay arrives at the InTrustBank Arena in Wichita, Kansas, for a pivotal Round 8 of the Arena Championship Series West. The stakes are higher than ever as the top two drivers in the series—Blake Granger and Armando Castro—face off in a high-pressure JCB Racing matchup that could shift the season leaderboard. Fans are treated to the technical brilliance of the Two Wheel Skills Challenge, featuring daring combos and gravity-defying maneuvers from the likes of Matt Cody in Grave Digger and Tim Hall Jr. in Jurassic Attack. The evening reaches a fever pitch during the Freestyle segment, where "Daredevil Diva" Angelina Nock takes Megalodon to the skies and Cliff Turner hunts for a breakthrough performance in Velociraptor. Witness the passion and raw power as these elite athletes push their 12,000-pound machines to the absolute edge for the Wichita crowd.

programme.desc: Os supercarros italianos são os carros mais excitantes do mundo. programme.title: Dreamcars

programme.title: Dreamcars

programme.title: Dreamcars

programme.title: Dreamcars

programme.title: Perfect Ride

programme.title: Perfect Ride

programme.title: Dreamcars

programme.title: Dreamcars

programme.desc: Quando Nick tenta ser espontâneo, mas Suzanne resiste e, em vez disso, planeja uma noite romântica que dá errado eles tentam ser espontâneos juntos—até perceberem que é melhor se ela fizer os planos.

programme.title: Are We There Yet?
programme.sub-title: O Episódio do Ela Não Fez Isso
programme.desc: Suzanne fica com ciúmes da jovem produtora de Nick. Quando Gigi se apaixona por um homem com filhos, ela pede ajuda a Kevin e Lindsey para se relacionar melhor com as crianças.

programme.title: Are We There Yet?
programme.sub-title: O Episódio do Nick Fazendo a Mão e o Pé
programme.desc: Suzanne se infiltra na noite de Nick com os rapazes. Ele revida, invadindo sua escapada para um spa só para mulheres.

programme.title: Prova de fogo: Uma História de Vida
programme.desc: Ela está determinada a soletrar até sair do sul de Los Angeles. Agarra chance de vencer o Concurso Nacional.

programme.title: Boo 2! Um Halloween de Madea
programme.desc: Não tenha medo - Madea e amigos estão de volta nessa continuação cômica e arrepiante do sucesso de Tyler Perry! Quando a filha de Brian (Tyler Perry) saiu para participar de uma festa em um acampamento assombrado, Madea, Bam, Hattie e Joe partiram para uma viagem aterrorizante para trazê-la de volta, assustando risadas e medo impressionante em todos os monstros, goblins e os animais da festa surgem no seu caminho.

programme.title: Entre Irmãos
programme.desc: Quando seu irmão mais velho desaparece no Afeganistão, Tommy, a ovelha negra da família, começa a cuidar de sua cunhada e suas sobrinhas, lidando com consequências que irão abalar os alicerces de toda a família.

programme.title: Como se tornar um conquistador
programme.desc: Nessa comédia de matar de rir, Eugenio interpreta o muito belo e jovem Mario, que sonha em ser rico sem trabalhar um só dia na vida. Tendo feito carreira em seduzir mulheres ricas mais velhas, ele se casa com uma ricaça com mais que o dobro de sua idade. Vinte e cinco anos depois, mimado e entediado de acordar ao lado da esposa, agora com quase 80 anos - ele tem a maior surpresa da vida quando ela acaba trocando ele por um vendedor de carros mais novo. Expulso de sua mansão e desesperado por um lugar para ficar, ele tem que ir morar com sua irmã distante, Sara (SALMA HAYEK) e seu filho nerd, mas adorável, Hugo, em seu pequeno apartamento. Conforme Maximo tenta reavivar seus poderes de amante latino, ele acaba se apegando ao seu sobrinho Hugo, e ele começa a aprender que ser um amante latino significa que amar o dinheiro não é tão importante quanto o amor de sua. família.

programme.title: No Vale das Sombras
programme.desc: Este filme aclamado é baseado na história verídica de uma família presa no tsunami de 2004 no sudeste da Ásia.

programme.title: Open Water
programme.desc: A couple find themselves stranded in the middle of the ocean, and at the mercy of a group of circling sharks.

programme.desc: A group of friends fails to lower their boat's ladder and find themselves stranded in the surrounding waters.

De plus, Joel est obsédé par son ex sexy. Mais étonnamment , ils tombent amoureux, jusqu'à ce qu'ils se séparent environ aux deux tiers du chemin, et Molly commence à sortir avec son comptable.

programme.title: Philadelphia Experiment II
programme.desc: Dans ce thriller de science-fiction, le survivant d’expériences de guerre est envoyé 41 ans dans le futur. Dans une course contre la montre, il doit sauver le monde en 1993.

programme.title: Une vie secrète
programme.desc: Sarah vivait une vie parfaite avec son mari Jason et leur fils Brandon, jusqu'à ce que Jason disparaisse. Le fils de Sarah souffre d'une maladie génétique rare et seul l'ADN de Jason peut le sauver. Quand Sarah retrouve enfin la trace de Jason, celui-ci fait en sorte que Sarah ne détruise pas sa vie secrète et ne révèle pas ses offenses passées.

programme.desc: Adolfo, cumpliendo su promesa a Rosalía, presiona a Alejandro para concretar el matrimonio ofreciéndole todas las facilidades. Marisela busca refugio en el alcohol mientras Consuelo lleva a Isaías a Alcohólicos Anónimos sin éxito. Erasto se cita con su abogado para dejar su fortuna a Consuelo, su única heredera legítima, ignorante de que Rosa también es su nieta. Arminda, ahora consciente del parentesco de Rosa, teme por su vida. Rosalía manipula a Andreína para espiar a Natalia, creyéndola su rival.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Leonardo le propone a Irene tener un niño, de ellos, para poder criarlo juntos. Luego, antes de ir a la oficina, Agustina le recuerda que esa noche será la celebración por los cincos años de la muerte de su ex esposa. Leo le confiesa a su amigo Jorge que no quiere comprometerse de ninguna manera con Oriana. Ella los escucha hablar y le deja en claro a Leo que no quiere nada más con él. Felipe descubre la identidad de Rodrigo, e Irene logra reconocerlo. Más tarde, Virginia visita la empresa para ver a su hermana, y se cruza con Rodrigo, quien le comenta que ahora cumple un cargo allí. Carlos Ernesto regresa a su casa del hospital. Su madre le exige que haga reposo, pero él sólo quiere trabajar para mantenerse ocupado y útil.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Sol visita a Madroño, quien le dice que la ayudará a probar que es hija de los Figueras. Más tarde, Reina y Alejandro aparecen en el hospital para visitar a Sol, luego de saber que la trasladaron allí. Sol los echa de su habitación, pero Alejandro se resiste y la besa apasionadamente. Luego de cuidar a su hijo toda la noche, Torombolo reconoce sin querer que está celoso de Bárbara, sin saber que Giselle estaba escuchando. Cuando ambas lo enfrentan, él logra zafarse del mal momento.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Brigitte lucha consigo misma para no dejar que Wilker la bese y finalmente pretextando un fuerte dolor de espalda se separa del muchacho y le pide que se marche y éste no entiende lo que pasa. Yubiri le cuenta a Solymar lo que piensa hacer con Wilker y con Juan Diego el gran hombre de su vida. Juan Diego enseña a Carolina a jugar pool pero Beto trata de hacerle entender que la muchacha es muy boba y él le dice que la necesita solamente como chica bonita y que no le importa que sea boba.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Jimena se encuentra indignada por la presencia de Virginia en la compañía, y le aclara a todos que quiere que respeten su decisión. Sin embargo, tanto Carlos Ernesto como Leonardo no aceptan esto, y pretenden buscar una manera de incluir a Virginia en la familia. Ricardo quiere recuperar a Oriana, y para volver a hacerlo, ella le propone que conquiste a María Lucía. Ricardo simula un encuentro casual y logra conversar con ella. Felipe trata de conseguir información del socio de Martín, pero él se niega a darle su nombre, ya que ese hombre lo sacará de la cárcel. En su regreso a la oficina, Felipe encuentra su escritorio desordenado y su caja fuerte abierta y vacía.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Aída está a punto de decirle la verdad sobre su bebé a Alejandro, pero entra Reina. La verdad seguirá esperando mientras Reina le ofrece a Aída mudarse con ellos para tenerla controlada, y la amenaza con matarla si no sostiene la mentira de su bebé. Crece el cariño entre Cristo José y Bárbara, unidos por su hijo. Giselle, a sabiendas de la situación, intenta que el amor no vuelva a florecer. José Domingo todavía está confundido por la noticia de Columba y Ricarda.

programme.title: O Golpe
programme.desc: Dois amigos de longa data, Deuce e Chucky, são especialistas em roubar lojas de penhores e joalherias e se envolvem em um plano para roubar um cofre da máfia. Eles são recrutados com um grupo de pequenos criminosos por Gerry “The Frenchman” Ouimette, o braço direito do chefe da máfia Providence, Raymond Patriarca. Patriarca é um notório gângster e matador que, embora esteja na prisão, continua administrando seu império do crime de dentro de sua cela bem equipada. A equipe realiza então o maior assalto da história americana: roubar mais de US$ 30 milhões do cofre de um negociante de peles que a Máfia usa como seu banco não oficial para armazenar dinheiro e bens roubados. Quando todas as pessoas que participaram do assalto começam a morrer, os dois amigos devem tentar se manter vivos para contar a história.

programme.title: Roubo a Máfia

programme.title: À Procura

Em uma corrida terrível contra o tempo, Matthew, os detetives e até mesmo Cass devem desempenhar as suas partes para resolver o mistério de seu desaparecimento e liberação do cativeiro

programme.title: Profissão de Risco

Mas Jack nunca conseguirá abrir a mala. Mas, no momento em que ele entra no motel, sua vida está em risco. Vários criminosos tentam tirar a bolsa dele e Jack precisa defendê-la se quiser viver.

programme.title: Valan - Vale dos Anjos
programme.desc: O policial Peter investiga diversos desaparecimentos de jovens mulheres em um caso de rede de tráfico sexual. A cada menina que encontra, lembranças de sua irmã Juli, desaparecida há mais de vinte anos, vêm à tona. Após uma ligação, Peter é convocado a voltar a sua cidade natal na Transilvânia para investigar o caso do aparecimento de um corpo que, supostamente, pode ser de sua irmã. programme.desc: En route to stop a train of explosives from arriving at Robotnik's munition factory, Sonic and Tails must deal with a duo of bears named Big Griz and Big Mike after Scratch and Grounder tell them that Sonic and Tails are the enemies.

programme.desc: When Sonic decides to find Tails a suitable foster home to ensure his safety, Robotnik finds out and creates a robot fox family, who pose as Tails' long-lost parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When overweight, elderly superhero Captain Rescue bungles in his attempts to help Sonic, he grows tired of his incompetence. Robotnik then uses Captain Rescue to successfully imprison Sonic in an impenetrable force field, and Tails and Captain Rescue must save him.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch suffers a blow to the head and believes that he is his favorite television character, Edgar Eagle. Sonic uses this to his advantage in preventing another of Robotnik's schemes.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: There is a Sonic Appreciation Day happening where Sonic is the guest in a hotel. However, someone steals his power sneakers and now Sonic and Tails have to find the culprit.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Tails adopts a cute and fuzzy pet named Walter who turns out to be a black hole who sucks up everything in Mobius. Realizing that Walter is from another dimension our heroes have to return him and they soon find themselves spinning through interdimensional limbo.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik opens up a resort to make the resident Mobians his slaves, Sonic enlists the help of some robots from an area of Mobius called Scrap Valley.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik creates a robot Sonic suit with the intent of ruining the hedgehog's reputation. He forces a lab rat named Laurence to pilot by threatening his parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Dr. Robotnik creates a genius chip so he would have enough brains to rule Mobius, however a computer hacker got hold of it which then the chip landed inside Grounder causing him to be smart.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog

When Tails is finally caught, Sonic speeds back to save him.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog

Sonic, Tails and Surff must avoid the undersea traps and Mobius sea monsters while Sonic rescues the Princess and reunites her with Surff -- making it look like Surff did the whole thing.

programme.desc: Robotnik reprograms a machine created by Von Schlemmer capable of turning dreams into reality, unleashing a Nightmare Monster upon Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik invents an electron altering generator which makes Scratch and Grounder twice as fast as Sonic. Seeing this, Robotnik convinces the villagers that the little fox belongs in jail, and Tails is forced to flee. programme.title: L'interview Qui Tue
programme.desc: Dave Skylark, anime le talk-show 'Skylark Tonight', au cours duquel il interviewe des célébrités sur des sujets intimes. Alors que Dave et son équipe fêtent leur 1000e épisode, ils découvrent que le dirigeant nord-coréen Kim Jong-un est un fan de leur émission, ce qui incite le producteur du spectacle Aaron Rapoport à lui proposer une interview. Cependant l'agent de la CIA Lacey propose à Dave et Aaron d'assassiner Kim pour faciliter un coup d'État. Ces derniers acceptent à contrecœur. Arrivés en Corée du Nord, ils s'apercevront que tout ne se passera pas aussi bien que prévu.

programme.title: The House Bunny
programme.desc: Après avoir passé sa vie au Manoir Playboy, Shelley, une playmate du célèbre magazine de charme, est injustement mise à la porte. Ne sachant où aller, elle atterrit dans une association d'étudiantes menacées d'expulsion si elles ne parviennent pas à attirer de nouveaux membres. Décidée à les aider, Shelley va utiliser toutes ses ressources de pin-up pour transformer les filles en créatures de rêve et faire de Zeta Alpha Zeta une des associations les plus populaires du campus...

programme.title: Garde Rapprochee
programme.desc: Sharp, un Texas Ranger habitué des dossiers sensibles, doit protéger les seuls témoins du meurtre de son indic : cinq pom-pom girls, incontrôlables et survoltées ! Il pensait avoir tout vu. Il va vite déchanter.

programme.title: White Chicks
programme.desc: Que faire quand on est les deux agents les plus nuls du FBI, qu’on est chargé d’escorter deux bimbos blondes menacées d’enlèvement, mais qu’on a un accident ? Prendre la place des deux minettes pour la soirée top-fashion de l’année !

programme.title: 21 Jump Street
programme.desc: Jenko et Schmidt quittent le lycée et s'engagent dans la police. A la suite de leur première arrestation ratée, les deux jeunes policiers sont convoqués par leur supérieur. Celui-ci leur annonce qu'ils sont mutés dans une cellule des années 80 récemment réactivée, l'unité «21 Jump Street». Dans une église désaffectée, Jenko et Schmidt rencontrent d'autres jeunes policiers. Tous ont été choisis pour infiltrer les milieux universitaires californiens en tant qu'étudiants. Leur objectif est de démanteler les réseaux de trafiquants de drogue. Ces recrues sont soumises à des règles précises : pas de relations avec les élèves et les enseignants, et pas d'achat d'alcool à leur place. programme.title: 22 Jump Street

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: For Rick Hendrick, the Corvette inspired his first car purchase, which ultimately led to the creation of his car dealership empire and motorsports teams. Mr. H, as he goes by, gives us a rare look inside of his personal Corvette collection and takes us to General Motors World Headquarters to talk with GM Vice President of Global Design, Ed Welburn, about how this iconic car came about. Country superstar Brad Paisley makes a cameo appearance to talk about his prized ‘Vette and the influence of cars on his music.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: The last car Elvis drove the evening he passed was his beloved Stutz Blackhawk. Ray discovers that the car has been preserved and heads to Graceland to check out this iconic piece of American music history. Ray and the team reveal the impeccable preservation of the car at Charlotte Motor Speedway with Rick Hendrick (“Mr. H”) and, arguably Elvis Presley’s biggest fan, Dale Earnhardt Jr. While at Graceland, Ray and the team also get an exclusive look at the paneled station wagon Elvis used to get in and out of Graceland in disguise. It’s an intimate look at the King’s incredible automobiles and their secrets that only Elvis knew.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: This episode takes an inside look at the famous racing L88 Corvette. From its history, to its successes and heartbreaks, to the stories of the men that drove it. Now, it’s a car world’s version of the Flinstones meet the Jetsons, as the Owens Corning Corvette, which clinched 22 straight race victories, challenges the new Corvette C7-R at Sebring International Raceway. The original Owens Corning team reunites for the challenge and our crew goes behind the scenes for the Corvette test drive of a lifetime.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: From break up to make up, Jeff Gordon and Ray reunite to go on a quest to find their Chevrolet Monte Carlo that claimed victory in their final race together at Phoenix, AZ in 1999. John Bickford, Jeff Gordon’s stepdad, makes the call that reunites the old team. Jeff and Ray look to bum parts off their boss, Rick Hendrick, to make their vision a reality: get the car, replace the parts as they were, make it run and get it to auction.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: One of the greatest battles in NASCAR history was Hall of Famer Richie Evans and rival speedster Jerry Cook. Ray is determined to uncover and revive the cars that made these men famous.Ray purchases one of Richie’s original #61 modifieds from Jimmy Spencer and restores it to its original glory while simultaneously building a replica of Jerry Cook’s #38. Throughout the build process, Ray uncovers stories about these legends through the eyes of guys who were in Rome, NY to witness it firsthand, like Robin Pemberton and Steve Hmiel.Both cars will hit the track at Martinsville, site of one of the greatest races in modified history and the tragic death of Richie Evans himself. Legends live again, as Ray recreates one of the racing world’s most celebrated rivalries on a track that has seen it all.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: General Motors VP of global design Ed Welburn takes AmeriCarna behind the scenes to talk about the history and development of the company’s concept cars that never made it to production. In a rare tour of the factory’s inner design studio, Ray gets an exclusive look behind the creative curtain at the GM plant in Detroit.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: In this episode, Ray celebrates the 50th birthday of the Ford Mustang through the lens of three distinct Mustang owners, who each hold a slice of the car’s incredible history. In 1964, Chicago schoolteacher Gail Wise unknowingly purchased the first ever Mustang 3 days before the car became available to the general public. Her husband reveals the incredible restoration that brought the earliest Mustang ever sold back to its 60’s glory. (Ford Motor Company knows she has the car and has verified it was sold before it was legal to sell.) John Grafelman is a farmer in Illinois and life-long Ford lover. A few years ago he found an old car hidden in a barn. It took some time, but he eventually convinced his friend to sell it to him. After some detective work, he discovers he purchased 1968 Ford Design Chief Larry Shinoda’s personal car that he tinkered with to invent the BOSS 302.Lastly, Ray travels to Dayton Ohio to interview Gale Holderman, the Ford stylist who won the company’s contest to draw and design the Mustang.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Post-World War II, a large generation of American soldiers was looking for cars that mirrored the incredible sports cars they saw overseas in Europe. After searching for an affordable way to recreate these cars, one manufacturer responded with a durable, cost effective option: a line of fiberglass sports cars. Very few of these cars still exist but there are collectors who are constantly looking to save parts and pieces of these virtually unknown vehicles. We learn about these rare cars from Geoff Hacker and his team at Forgotten Fiberglass, and take a visit to the Smithsonian Museum, which houses a fiberglass car of its own. This episode presents a unique look at how the narrative of American wartime experiences often shaped the nation’s automotive demands.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Vintage Testarossas and Quatra Valve Ferraris don’t just show up on a dealer’s floor, they’re hunted! Adam Merlin, exotic car expert, has spent a lifetime searching for the cars that defined his youth, but nothing is assumed or given in his high stakes game of Risk; A muscle car fiend shows off his private collection to host Skip Smith.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: The word is out that Caffeine & Octane is the major league of North American car shows. Former Atlanta Brave, World Series star, and 10-Time Gold Glove winner Andruw Jones acknowledged the stardom and showed up to show off his 6 wheeled Super Jeep. The state of the art creation took years in planning and execution, but Jones chooses one great event for its debut.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: The natural landscape of Jekyll Island, GA makes for a great backdrop to showcase the country’s greatest cars. But the ocean air and remoteness of this GA barrier island is no place to leave a painstakingly rebuilt ‘59 Imperial Speedster. Host Skip Smith makes it his mission to locate the talented builder behind this island mystery. Guest host Totem joins Bryan Fuller in the C&O lots to pick out his favorites.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Imagination, ingenuity, and heartache join friends who set out with a simple goal of transforming a ‘35 Plymouth into a running taxi cab. Provenance and passion take center stage as families and friends strive for best in show. Host Rickey Gadson checks out perfect replicas of the original Shelby Cobras and takes Skip and Bryan on ‘borrowed’ taxi ride.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Call the Peach State Challengers a “car club” and you will quickly be corrected. The defenders of everything Dodge are “family” and they make no excuses for their loyalty to brand and brother. Spend a day at the track with these Challengers and find out what their version of the family photo looks like.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Former Jet Ski Champion Ryan Hardwick has succeeded in everything he’s touched in racing and business, so why not race Lamborghinis! Hardwick has found rapid success with his high tech training methods; he shares his secrets with host Rickey Gadson in this episode of C&O.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Daimlers and Morgans, and Citroens, oh my! Caffeine & Octane is known for having something for everyone. That reputation grows stronger as Bob Boston’s collection, on the lunatic fringe of automotive, rattles into an event; guest host Katherine Legge explains the competitor to her racing sponsor Acura, Porsche.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Early spring in Jekyll Island, GA is something to behold. Add a few hundred of the country’s coolest rides for Caffeine & Octane at the Beach, and it’s a thing of beauty. Models that blasted the glass ceiling of expectation at the all makes and models show include a hand-built, twin-turbo Tucker, a one-off 1951 Kaiser Drag’N, and a Roadkill Custom known only as Blasphemi!

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Ray explores buying a unique, hand built car the Schultz family has kept in their New Jersey home for years. The car was originally called the Schultz El Fierro but it’s officially titled in New Jersey as a “Schultz Special” from 1958. It was used to drag race and held numerous racing records, but most important to the family was that it was driven by the legendary Carroll Shelby. With a frame and style much similar to the Shelby Roadster, the Schultz family wonders if it inspired one of the most well known automobiles in America. In another epic New Jersey story, Ray finds Mario Andretti’s 1965 IndyCar. The catch: it’s completely in pieces hidden away in a garage. The iconic driver talks about his days on the track with that car and Ray attempts to negotiate a deal to buy the parts.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: How do you cast a car in a movie? What are the secrets to the build? Hollywood car designers give Ray the ultimate tour of some memorable movie cars, including a look at the recently found “Hells Chariot”, the last surviving car from Grease. We also hear the backstory to “Bumble Bee” from Transformers, take a look at the making of the tanks for Hunger Games and stumble upon the iconic 1958 Chevy Impala from American Graffiti.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: While visiting the estate of automotive genius and land speed record holder Willie Glass, Ray uncovers a set of extremely rare Ardun cylinder heads, which is a hot rodders dream discovery. He also visits the infamous H & H Flatheads outside of Los Angeles and discovers a surprise connection to the Earnhardt family.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: A massive sinkhole opened underneath the National Corvette Museum in Kentucky. Eight amazing cars were swallowed up, including the 1,000,000th Corvette. AmeriCarna was given exclusive access to document the removal of the cars from the sinkhole and the painstaking restoration of the 1,000,000th Corvette.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: On the beaches of Wildwood, NJ, an iconic vintage race, The Race of Gentleman, takes place annually: period cars, period dress, pure authenticity. Ray puts a car in the race with a very special driver, who turns out not to be a Gentleman.

programme.title: Deer and Deer Hunting
programme.desc: The team breaks down how, when, and where to create mock scrapes to attract and inventory mature bucks on your hunting property. From the science behind licking branches to choosing the perfect locations and using trail cameras to monitor activity, this episode is packed with practical tips that any hunter can use.

programme.title: Deer and Deer Hunting
programme.desc: Dan Schmidt sits down with Auburn University professor Dr. Steve Ditchkoff to tackle one of the most debated topics in deer management: cull bucks. Is there real science behind the idea of removing “inferior” bucks to improve herd genetics, or is it more myth than management?

programme.title: Deer and Deer Hunting
programme.desc: Whitetail deer have a unique four-chambered stomach that helps them digest tough plant material and adapt to seasonal diets. In this episode of Deer & Deer Hunting, Dan Schmidt and Josh Honeycutt break down the whitetail’s digestive system and what it means for you as a hunter.

programme.title: Deer and Deer Hunting
programme.desc: When temperatures plummet and the landscape is buried in snow, the whitetail deer’s true resilience is put to the test.

programme.title: The Cast
programme.desc: Trenton makes a trip to Louisiana to fish with Theophile Bourgeois at the Cajun Vista Lodge. With an early rain delay, they took a tour of the lodge and learned about its long standing family history before hitting the water for some redfish.

programme.title: The Cast
programme.desc: Trenton stays close to home and heads to the Lake of The Ozarks joining Austin Culbertson for a frigid couple days of fishing. The cold weather doesn’t hold back the fish, though, as they target brush piles with jerk baits and umbrella rigs.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy and his friend Scotty take on Kodiak Island, Alaska for an adventure of Salmon fishing and hunting black tail deer. Whilst traversing steep mountains in the company of Kodiak brown bears and taking on cold Alaskan waters, Andy presents useful information for fellow outdoor enthusiasts all whilst building friendships with the great people of Kodiak Big Timber Lodge.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy goes back to his home farm in Alabama for deer and quail hunting. Not only does he make incredible dishes with his former ‘masterchef’ contestant Alex which he serves to local children in need but he explains how hunting is never about “just the hunt” but about the camaraderie, friendship and memories made through the pursuit of the harvest.

programme.title: Duck Camp Dinners
programme.desc: With the drought ending and rain headed their way, the crew hunts the final days of the first split in Bayou Black with new friends Jesse Griffiths and Dirk Sorrells.

programme.title: Duck Camp Dinners

programme.title: The Raven Project

programme.title: The Raven Project

programme.title: The Raven Project

programme.title: The Raven Project - "Raven Whitetails"

The brothers spend a day in the boat with Bryant Stark of Rising Rivers, fishing the White and the Norfork. Though the White is much larger waters than back home, Trevor utilizes his experience to catch them even while wading.

programme.title: The Cast
programme.desc: Trenton makes a trip to South Carolina to fish Lake Murray. He meets up with the Rather Outdoors crew to spend time on the water and at the Rather HQ checking out all the gear from Lews and Strike King.

programme.title: The Cast
programme.desc: The Crew is chasing Tarpon in Tampa Florida with Ryan Harrington. After a few close calls and grinding out the long days, they finally catch up to the Silver King.

programme.title: The Cast
programme.desc: The Southards continue their family tradition on Table Rock Lake. While they’re there, Trenton spends a day with “Mr. Worldwide” James Watson and learns some things from one of the best anglers on the lake.

programme.title: Super Retriever
programme.desc: The Super Retriever Series Crown Championship brings together the nation’s top canine athletes and handlers in Shreveport-Bossier City, Louisiana. In Part 1 of the Amateur Division, teams face off in challenging Retriever Trials alongside high-energy SRS Super Dock competition. Precision, power, and teamwork are put to the test as the road to the Crown begins.

programme.title: Super Retriever
programme.desc: The Amateur Division reaches its climax at the Super Retriever Series Crown Championship. Top teams battle through the final rounds of Retriever Trials, where every point matters. In the end, one standout handler and dog team rises above the rest to be crowned Amateur SRS Crown Champions. At the same time, the excitement continues on the dock as fun-loving canine athletes compete for their own Crown victories in SRS Super Dock.

programme.title: HuntStand Presents
programme.desc: For decades, Paul Butski has set the standard in turkey calling. His name is etched into the NWTF Grand National Calling Championships Hall of Fame, and his influence stretches far beyond the stage. He didn’t just win competitions, he shaped the way we talk to turkeys – and more importantly, the way we hunt them.

programme.title: HuntStand Presents
programme.desc: Todd Rogers embraces the business of being a hunting outfitter as a labor of love. And while so many family-run operations are dwindling in rural America, the Rogers legacy is here to stay. Will Cooper and Josh Dahlke return to western Oklahoma to share this story while pursuing brush-country whitetails in the red dirt.

programme.title: HuntStand Presents
programme.desc: Ismael Garcia was just a young soldier when a tragic incident in Afghanistan changed his life forever. He was left wounded and scarred, but the hardest part came after he returned home. Hunting had always been his escape. But after war, everything felt different — until he picked up a bow.

programme.title: HuntStand Presents
programme.desc: Will Cooper finally trades 3 years of tough times for triumph in his quest to tag an out-of-state buck with a bow.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.sub-title: "Opening Week in Mississippi started off with a BANG!!"
programme.desc: Opening day in Mississippi has arrived and Slade is taking full advantage of it! With the weather not cooperating Slade and Zeb stumble into a turkey hunt they won't soon forget. Two days later, the hot streak continues with Slade connecting on another turkey on an 83 acre property he has for sale! Also, Slade gives some tips and his ideas on small acreage hunting, and how it can be just as lucrative as big tracks of land!

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode, Slade and his son take on the turkey woods for an afternoon hunt. Although the woods remained quiet, a tom soon snuck out of the woods and on the end of Bentley's barrel! After that Slade was able to help a client of his harvest his first turkey! And boy was it an action packed hunt! Jakes, hens, and tons of gobbles, This hunt is spectacular! Lastly, Slade introduces a property that we have already made a video on, but with just how amazing the land is, we had to include it! Floweree is the epitome of a sportsman's paradise!
